to 16.5 ft (5 m), nitrogen filled, AquaDura lens coating
close-focus lens, hand strap, eyepiece cover, leather pouch
products.warranty: 30-year manufacturer's warranty on optical defects plus a free, transferable 10-year Passport Protection Plan for accidental damage when bought from an authorized North American dealer; non-optical accessories 2 years.
products.returns: Leica USA store: returns within 7 days of receipt with the sales receipt, new condition, original box, not registered; 15% restocking fee if those conditions are not met. Free UPS Ground shipping over $100.
products.summary: Leica's 2026 pocket monocular: 8x25, 5.4 oz, 90% light transmission, focuses to 6 ft, and to about 10 inches with the close-up lens in the box.
products.fit: Birders who want the sharpest pocket view and close focus for feeder birds, warblers in brush, butterflies and dragonflies. It also works as a magnifier for flowers, insects and museum pieces.
caveats: On 2026-11-11 Leica's US store listed it as Notify Me (out of stock).
On BirdForum, owners of the Monovid 8x20 and 8x25 call the focus stiff, and four posters say the view shakes at 8x.
One BirdForum owner reports loose eyecup play and uneven leather seams on the 8x25.
One eye tires sooner than two on long birding sessions.
